R&D — Breakdown

Procedural Head

One Houdini head asset produces 72 face-feature styles and 50 mixed faces. A parameter-driven deformer reshapes each feature in place — no re-sculpting: six features (face shape, eyes, brows, nose, mouth, ears), 12 styles per feature, picked from a style menu where entry 0 always returns the original head.

Every style is cached to disk and rendered in Karma XPU with a fixed 100 mm mugshot camera and flat flash lighting, so every frame compares side by side. A balanced random mixer then builds 50 whole faces, each combining one style per feature. The whole pipeline runs headless from Python (hython) — any wedge rebuilds by deleting its cache and rerunning the script.
